root: Dedicated new D scratch directory only; no databases or formal performance runs.

cases.expect: At least one original sealed segment actually absent, archived bytes unchanged, reconstructed original events/seq exactly equal.
Required version/read source parsed from archive rather than SQLite claims; cold removal cannot remove factual dependency.
Pin late reader transaction retains initial and transitive writer/predecessor transaction segments hot.
Missing tx/version/seq source refuses pin/prune; no future version backfill.
Actual active TX, unread reference or disconnect/unknown commit rejects adoption/prune.
Relation/list/SQL-condition sources explicitly reject prune and complete window claim.
Actual retained old journal append after close invalidates original source; reconstructed view cannot bypass marker.
Changed, deleted or dangling-symlink original writer.lock rejects managed reads and stable reopen remains rejected while fence exists.
Original failure/invalidation marker, including dangling symlink, defeats otherwise healthy archive.
Before and after actual prune, missing/bad archive makes complete unavailable; old evidence preserved.
Duplicate, extra, path traversal, symlink, encrypted or oversized members rejected without unsafe extraction.
Location/hash/generation/checkpoint/root changes or unknown segment names cannot yield complete.
Real WAL/SHM, altered cache/schema/identities rejected by reconstructed raw JournalReader; archive bytes do not waive it.
Held real OS lease prevents prune and explicit recovery, without deleting any original segment.
Separate process exits after synced intent; complete blocked; exact explicit recovery revalidates and resumes.
Separate process exits before unlink; new process sees pending state and must recover before complete.
Some exact original segments absent but complete raw events remain in verified archive; recovery handles mixed presence.
Wrong nonce/plan or live OS lock cannot be stolen; no automatic lock removal.
No complete receipt, operation remains fenced; missing source not repaired from cache/search.
Manifest/directory sync failure plus marker failure cannot expose complete state; existing lock remains.
Disk/temp/IO/event/root/segment/cooperative wall budget exhaustion is explicit, no unbounded full-log materialization.
All checkpoint/window/source archive references remain; archive delete API always refuses.
Marker/archive/manifest change while iterating prevents successful complete EOF even after a prefix was yielded.
Post-publication byte/hash mismatch prevents success, old failed files retained.

receiptRule: Record actual per-case pass/failure only after execution, exact source pre/post hashes, source/index/archive/manifest bindings, raw original deletion counts and explicit not-executed fields. No DB/performance/independent-acceptance inference.
